While the quartet uses a wide assortment of artists and instruments, one fairly constant member of the group is violinist Tom Tally. While the group is referred to as a string quartet, the reality is that more individuals are usually involved, using instruments such as violins, cellos, percussion, brass and woodwinds. The group was originally brought together in 1999 as an experimental project.
